# Fixtures for `dex` (Android DEX)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The programs print a fictitious harbour's tide table (Saltmere Harbour). Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/bytecode.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides-release.dex` | d8 8.5.35 --release --min-api 21 (DEX 035) from the Java 8 class | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-debug.dex` | d8 8.5.35 --debug --min-api 28 (DEX 039) from the Java 8 class with debug information | CC0-1.0 |
